contract: Ordinary no-reference public query, fetch URL and HTTP request body reach real loopback receivers byte-for-byte; no additional confirmation flow.
With protection enabled private-reference query, URL and body each independently refuse before toolCall dispatch; no receiver hits and no original-value bytes.
Off passes opaque references literally; it does not restore prior-scope originals.

limitations: Configured fake DeepSeek endpoint tests actual API query/fetch payloads; public page target uses literal public IP without contacting it. Native HTTP uses a real loopback receiver.
Existing network safety checks were not replaced/mocked. The separate regression covers their current behavior.
This does not protect arbitrary manually entered plaintext or arbitrary scripts/MCP networking, and does not claim generic HTTP full-chain privacy.
No real provider, external platform, user data or release package acceptance.
